name: AI Agent for SEO Content – Republish AI
author: RepublishAI.com

sections.description:
The RepublishAI Plugin securely connects your WordPress sites to the RepublishAI AI Agent powered SEO content platform.

The RepublishAI plugin creates a secure connection between your WordPress sites and the RepublishAI platform, enabling you to effortlessly create, update, and optimize your blog content without ever logging into WordPress.
With RepublishAI and its intelligent AI Agents, you can automatically research and write comprehensive SEO-optimized articles, instantly refresh outdated content to boost rankings, generate context-specific images with a single click, and manage content across multiple WordPress sites from one intuitive interface.
RepublishAI offers specialized AI Agents that handle the heavy lifting of content creation. AI Agent Atlas creates detailed, highly optimized 3,000+ word articles targeting your keywords, while AI Agent Nova identifies outdated content and refreshes it with current information to improve search rankings.
RepublishAI is the ideal solution for bloggers looking to scale content production, SEO professionals seeking to improve rankings, content marketers managing multiple sites, and anyone who wants to create high-quality WordPress content without the hassle of WordPress editing.

Why Choose RepublishAI for WordPress Content Creation?

RepublishAI streamlines your entire content workflow with its powerful AI Agents that handle research, writing, and optimization. Our intuitive editor eliminates WordPress frustrations while maintaining full control over your content. The platform is designed to boost SEO with smart keyword targeting and content refreshing, and effortlessly scales to manage content across multiple WordPress sites.
All of this makes RepublishAI the most advanced AI-powered solution for WordPress content creation, helping you drive more traffic and save countless hours on content production.

Key Features

  • AI Agent Atlas – Automatically researches and writes detailed, highly optimized 3,000+ word articles strategically targeting your keywords.
  • AI Agent Nova – Instantly identifies outdated blog content, researches current trends, and refreshes your posts—effortlessly boosting your SEO rankings.
  • 10X Faster AI Blog Editor – Effortlessly manage multiple WordPress sites, using an AI-powered workspace, rapidly generate new content, rewrite existing posts, and instantly produce engaging, context-specific images.
  • Yoast SEO Integration – Automatically optimize Yoast SEO meta titles, descriptions, and focus keywords with AI-powered suggestions. Edit Yoast details directly within RepublishAI with one-click optimization.
  • AI-Generated Images: Create engaging, context-specific images with a single click.
  • Multi-Site Management – Control content across multiple WordPress sites from one interface
  • REST API Integration – Secure connection between WordPress and Republish AI
  • Application Password Support – Secure authentication without sharing your admin credentials
  • Gutenberg Block Support – Full compatibility with the WordPress block editor
  • Cross-Origin Resource Sharing – Secure connection to your WordPress site from the Republish AI app

Benefits

  • Increase Search Engine Traffic and improve SEO Rankings – AI-driven research and optimization to boost your search traffic
  • Save Time – Let AI agents handle content creation and updates, freeing you to focus on strategy
  • Maintain Content Freshness – Automatically update old content to keep it relevant
  • Streamline Workflow – Manage multiple sites from one intuitive interface
  • Enhance Content Quality – AI assistance for better, more engaging, and more thorough content
  • Blog Post Versioning System – Make updates to your blog content with historical version history of each post.

How It Works

  1. Connect WordPress – Install this plugin and create an application password for secure API access
  2. Link to Republish AI – Enter your WordPress site details in the Republish AI dashboard
  3. Start Creating – Use the AI agents to research, write, and update your content automatically

Additional Information

Application Passwords

This plugin requires WordPress application passwords, which are available in WordPress 5.6 and later. Application passwords provide a secure way for external applications to connect to your WordPress site without sharing your admin password.

Minimum Requirements

  • WordPress 5.6 or higher
  • PHP 7.4 or higher
  • HTTPS enabled for secure connections
  • REST API enabled

Privacy Policy

Republish AI respects your privacy and the privacy of your site visitors. For more information about how we handle data, please visit our Privacy Policy.
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Log in to your WordPress admin panel
  2. Go to “Plugins” -> “Add New”
  3. Search for “Republish AI”
  4. Click “Install Now” and then “Activate”

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file
  2. Log in to your WordPress admin panel
  3. Go to “Plugins” -> “Add New”
  4. Click “Upload Plugin” at the top of the page
  5. Choose the downloaded ZIP file and click “Install Now”
  6. Activate the plugin

Configuration

  1. Go to “Republish AI” in your WordPress admin menu
  2. Follow the setup instructions to create an application password
  3. Login to republishai.com and enter your WordPress site details to connect your site
sections.faq:
Is Republish AI free to use?

The Republish AI editor is free to use. The wordPress plugin is free to install and set up. To use the AI agents and AI content creation features, you’ll need a Republish AI account, which offers various subscription plans.

How secure is the connection between WordPress and Republish AI?

Republish AI uses WordPress application passwords for secure authentication. This means:
– Your admin password is never shared
– You can revoke access at any time
– Each connected app has its own password
– Communication is secured via HTTPS

Can I use Republish AI with multiple WordPress sites?

Yes! Republish AI is designed to manage multiple WordPress sites from a single interface. Install the plugin on each site, connect them to your Republish AI account, and manage all your content in one place.

Does Republish AI work with Gutenberg blocks?

Yes, Republish AI fully supports the WordPress block editor (Gutenberg). The plugin includes special handling for blocks, allowing AI agents to work with your existing content structure.

Does Republish AI integrate with Yoast SEO?

Yes! You can automatically optimize your Yoast SEO meta titles, descriptions, and focus keywords using AI. Edit and manage all Yoast SEO details directly within the RepublishAI interface with one-click optimization.

Can I review content before it’s published?

Absolutely! Republish AI puts you in control. You can review, edit, and approve all content before it’s published to your WordPress site.

Do I need technical knowledge to use Republish AI?

No technical knowledge is required. Our intuitive interface makes it easy to create and manage content, even for beginners.

Can I control what content Republish AI creates or updates?

Absolutely. You have full control over what content is created or updated. You can review and edit all content before publishing.

How do I get support?

If you need help with the plugin, please visit our support site or contact us through the Republish AI dashboard.
